layer1_context.context: complete 35-voxel receptive field inside the source field of view; 84 mm cube centered on the nodule, retained native positions 5-16

stage2.context: deployed 72 mm input window; instance normalization uses whole-window statistics

stage3.context: deployed 72 mm input window; instance normalization uses whole-window statistics

random_encoder.initialization: MONAI default parameter initialization; BatchNorm running statistics at initialization; evaluation mode

acceptance_roles.representation: max_development_fvu, min_mean_token_cosine, max_inactive_fraction and l0_relative_tolerance are reported diagnostics
acceptance_roles.selection_gate: max_probability_mae, max_auroc_decrease and max_ap_decrease under full replacement of the deployed map

selection.objective: per site, the smallest k whose reference-seed dictionary passes the fixed-classifier checks, expansion 4, training length from the budget diagnostic; stable features defined by cross-seed reappearance

budget_diagnostic.question: whether more SAE training tokens on the same matrices raise cross-seed feature reappearance

nodule_coverage.question: whether training-token composition and training length make features of the nodule region reappear across seeds
nodule_coverage.pool_rule: nodule-pool variants draw the configured fraction of every training batch (training.nodule_pool.fraction: 0.5 for nodule4x and nodule16x, 0.75 for nodule75) from positions of training records within 10 mm of the target nodule surface, split evenly over inside, 0-4 mm and 4-10 mm; the rest keeps the uniform training matrix; development matrices are unchanged
nodule_coverage.criterion: at each site, variance explained by stable features at nodule positions (inside or within 4 mm of the surface, development patients) is at least the variance they explain at positions more than 10 mm from the surface, the reference seed passes the fixed-classifier checks, and stable nodule-related features exceed the random-weight control in the production set; the cheapest passing variant is chosen
nodule_coverage.sufficiency: user decision 2026-10-15 19:25 EDT (option A): a site is sufficient for nodule interpretation when, on the 8-seed production dictionaries, all seeds pass the fixed-classifier checks, stable nodule-specific features (nodule enrichment >= 3 on development patients) clearly exceed both the tokens4x dictionaries and the random-weight control, and stable-feature explained variance at the nodule region exceeds that of tokens4x; the nodule-versus-far coverage comparison is reported as a description
nodule_coverage.criterion_addition: added after the first comparison results: the stable-feature explained variance at the nodule region must also not fall below that of the current tokens4x dictionaries, so that a smaller gap cannot come only from lower background coverage
nodule_coverage.layer2_compact_reason: FMCIB layer2 stays below the background after nodule75 (-0.038, bootstrap interval -0.073 to -0.001) while stable features carry a fixed quarter of the nodule activation for every pool fraction; expansion 2 and k8 test whether a more compact dictionary stops nodule concepts from splitting into seed-specific features; the layer2 classifier MAE (0.0096) leaves room
nodule_coverage.stage3_e8_reason: VISTA3D stage3 k32 nodule4x passes the classifier (MAE 0.0218) but keeps 76 stable features and 0.055 stable explained variance at the nodule; stage3 has little classifier headroom even uniformly (tokens4x MAE 0.0230-0.0249), so expansion 8 at k16 tests whether more capacity keeps the background reconstruction while adding nodule features; the stage3 nodule75 runs at k16 and k32 were withdrawn before training
nodule_coverage.stage3_k32_reason: VISTA3D stage3 k16 with nodule-pool training exceeds the fixed-classifier probability MAE gate (nodule4x 0.0294, nodule16x 0.0290 at seed 2025), so by the smallest-passing-k rule stage3 is also trained at k32
nodule_coverage.nodule75_reason: with half of each batch from the nodule pool the gap narrowed (layer2 -0.427 to -0.061, stage2 -0.084 to -0.009) without closing; nodule75 draws three quarters of each batch from the pool (one quarter per band), half of the batch within 4 mm of the surface
nodule_coverage.hosts: FMCIB layer2 runs on Mayo; VISTA3D nodule16x comparison runs and random-weight production runs on Mayo, the remaining VISTA3D runs on the local GPU, so that both machines finish together

production.basis: k is the smallest grid value whose reference-seed dictionary passes the fixed-classifier checks; at every site cross-seed reappearance decreases as k increases. Expansion 4: expansion 8 changes the variance explained by stable features by -0.008 to +0.056 across sites without a consistent direction and doubles the features to inspect. Training length 4x from the budget diagnostic.

reused_caches.rule: the viewer reads browser caches of the unchanged production dictionaries from the earlier whole-CT run

whole_ct.regions: lung and liver from FLARE-AutoMSC masks; other tissue HU in (-500, 300) outside lung and liver; high HU >= 300; edge air HU < -950 within the outer 10% of the in-plane field
whole_ct.scope: Each dictionary is applied to its training-sized window on a regular whole-CT grid; maps keep the window's central native positions so neighbouring windows tile the scan. FMCIB layer1 complete-context maps keep positions whose 35-voxel receptive field lies inside the CT volume.

candidates.references_rule: rank correlation with each reference measurement on discovery patients after removing the rank of log nodule volume from both; size_rho is the unadjusted rank correlation with log volume
candidates.selection: Discovery (training patients): stable features of the reference seed whose size-adjusted partial correlation exceeds the random-weight reference seed's 95th percentile of absolute values. Confirmation (development patients): same sign and Benjamini-Hochberg q below the false discovery rate within the discovery-selected set of each site and encoder; a feature without confirmation variance counts as p = 1.
